name: argos
description: Argos, the hundred-eyed watcher: no PR sits idle without someone noticing.

account.title: gh account
account.description: gh login used by the vigil. Empty = the active account.

qualifiers.title: Extra search filter
qualifiers.description: Extra GitHub search qualifiers (e.g. is:draft). The vigil only watches repos connected with /argos repos add.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, the pane and the notices.

intervalMinutes.title: Interval (min)
intervalMinutes.description: How often the vigil runs, in minutes, and auto-validate with it. Minimum 5.

skills.title: Validation skills
skills.description: Skills every validation reads as references, comma separated (e.g. security-review, api-style). A repo adds its own with /argos repos skills <repo> <skills>.

validatePromptMode.title: Validate prompt
validatePromptMode.description: What Validate asks: Argos's own job plus your prompt, Argos's alone, or yours alone.

validatePrompt.title: Your validate prompt
validatePrompt.description: Your own words for validating a PR (what to look for, house rules). Verdicts are always recorded so the pane can show them.

fixPromptMode.title: Fix prompt
fixPromptMode.description: What Fix my PRs asks: Argos's own job plus your prompt, Argos's alone, or yours alone.

fixPrompt.title: Your fix prompt
fixPrompt.description: Your own words for fixing your PRs from their review (style, what to run before pushing).

runLimitMinutes.title: Time limit per PR (min)
runLimitMinutes.description: A PR still validating after this many minutes counts as failed and can be retried.
